caption: The drawing features a central bird with outstretched wings, rendered in shades of pink with black and white details. Surrounding the bird are multiple blooming roses, primarily in pink, with green leaves and stems extending throughout the composition. The background is predominantly black, which highlights the floral elements and the central bird. Around the central section, there are symmetrical arrangements of stylized decorative elements that resemble ornate scrolls, foliage, and abstract forms in pink, green, and white tones. The pattern appears mirrored along both horizontal and vertical axes, with pairs of bird heads or creature-like figures, as well as repeated rose motifs distributed evenly across the image. The entire illustrated section is set against an off-white or beige background, with the drawing contained within a rectangular frame centered on the page.
title: Wall Paper
